lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Guided practice: washer and dryer safety

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice washer and dryer safety. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: With a trusted adult present at the washer and dryer, the learner practices loading a wash following three safety behaviors, first with the adult narrating each check, then a second time with the learner leading and the adult confirming.
safetyNotes: A trusted adult must be present for the entire loading and starting process.
Hands stay clear of the drum at all times while the machine is running.
Stop and ask the adult for help if the machine makes an unfamiliar noise or shows an error.

simulationAlternative.description: If no washer or dryer is available in the home, the learner instead reviews a labeled diagram or short adult-led walkthrough of a washer and dryer (at a laundromat, a relative's home, or a printed diagram) and, with the adult, verbally walks through where and how each of the three checks would happen, then explains each check's purpose the same way as the real-machine reflection.

materials: adult-or-local: a load of real laundry

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Pick one of the three safety behaviors and explain, in your own words, exactly what could go wrong if that specific check were skipped — not just 'it's dangerous,' but what would actually happen.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Following the three safety checks: Completes all three checks with adult support. | Explaining the 'why': Explains a plausible specific consequence for at least one check. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner teach the three safety behaviors to a younger sibling or family member, with the adult present to confirm the teaching is accurate.

resources.title: washer and dryer safety worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: With a trusted adult present at the washer and dryer, the learner practices loading a wash following three safety behaviors, first with the adult narrating each check, then a second time with the learner leading and the adult confirming.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact washer and dryer safety decision or action.
Model move 2: Before practicing, name one thing you think could go wrong if someone loaded a washer or dryer without checking it first.

Model move 3: With your adult, load one wash following three checks: pockets checked and emptied, load size checked against the machine's fill line, and hands kept clear of the drum while it's running.
Model check: Following the three safety checks: Completes all three checks with adult support. | Explaining the 'why': Explains a plausible specific consequence for at least one check.

resources.title: washer and dryer safety action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for washer and dryer safety.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: washer and dryer safety coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: With a trusted adult present at the washer and dryer, the learner practices loading a wash following three safety behaviors, first with the adult narrating each check, then a second time with the learner leading and the adult confirming.
Coach direction: Before practicing, name one thing you think could go wrong if someone loaded a washer or dryer without checking it first.
Learner prompt: Name one possible problem.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: washer and dryer safety complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: With your adult, load one wash following three checks: pockets checked and emptied, load size checked against the machine's fill line, and hands kept clear of the drum while it's running.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I checked every pocket on every item before loading.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I checked the load against the fill line rather than guessing.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I did not reach into the machine at any point while it was running.
Response 4 (t2-p4): My adult was present for the entire loading and starting process.

Equal-access rule: If no washer or dryer is available in the home, the learner instead reviews a labeled diagram or short adult-led walkthrough of a washer and dryer (at a laundromat, a relative's home, or a printed diagram) and, with the adult, verbally walks through where and how each of the three checks would happen, then explains each check's purpose the same way as the real-machine reflection.

resources.title: washer and dryer safety minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.

Reflection: Pick one of the three safety behaviors and explain, in your own words, exactly what could go wrong if that specific check were skipped — not just 'it's dangerous,' but what would actually happen.
Success checks: Following the three safety checks: Completes all three checks with adult support. | Explaining the 'why': Explains a plausible specific consequence for at least one check.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: washer and dryer safety supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional washer and dryer safety condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Following the three safety checks: Completes all three checks with adult support. | Explaining the 'why': Explains a plausible specific consequence for at least one check..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u02-l03-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

realRoute.title: washer and dryer safety — permitted real-life route
realRoute.permissionRule: Do not begin the physical action until a household-authorized guardian gives permission and is available for the supervision or review named in this lesson.
steps: Confirm the setting, materials, and stop condition before acting.
With your adult, load one wash following three checks: pockets checked and emptied, load size checked against the machine's fill line, and hands kept clear of the drum while it's running.
Complete the response prompts on the delivered independent card without recording private identifying details.
Check the result against the delivered evidence record and correct any missed step.

guardianInvolvement.role: Give permission; provide only the supervision, handling, review, or observation named in the lesson; attest only that the physical event occurred.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.

may: coach the guided and retry cards

tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
